selection: Select the safe fixed reference with most fully ready departures, then least unmet energy and incremental charging cost. For learned candidates first require at least one percentage point more fully ready departures, lower unmet energy, and no more than 1% higher incremental unit cost against that reference on validation; then rank by readiness, unmet energy and incremental bill. If none qualifies retain the best candidate only as an explicitly unaccepted experiment. Select the strongest unlearned candidate independently by the same readiness-first ranking. Freeze before test execution.
cost: Site bill and incremental EV bill over a same-weather no-EV counterfactual, divided by battery kWh delivered. This is service-normalised accounting, not proof of equivalent-service savings.
